authority: 2026-09-07 user approval of the gated fast development loop
claim: measure the cost and completion of exact continuation on one fixed production bundle, not discovery performance
source_role: inspected PARP1 development source, not held-out evaluation
bundle_selection: lexicographically first BUILD_RING_SYSTEM bundle ID in the completed option audit; no selection on score or completion
executor_meter_scope: all public RewriteSystem.apply calls during profiling, including calls inside law enumeration; runtime initialization is separate and timed
terminal_weight: complete program with increased cycle rank and ring-system count relative to source; profile-only structural event, not T4 value

compute.expected_wall_time: unmeasured for this backup; historical complete T4 proposal round 2208.4 seconds is not this unit

restart_unit: complete exact augmented-state reference row; persist law and row payloads with physical hashes, never publish partial rows as a law

acceptance.identities: exact image bytes, run paths and checkpoint hashes match; frozen runtime initializes without relaxed gates
acceptance.support: same production evaluator, option support and executor; no additional top-k or support restriction
acceptance.budget: all attempted executor calls counted, including rejected and partial-row work; cap never exceeded
acceptance.cache: exact slot/charge/hydrogen/context/lineage/phase identity; persisted state/action/probability payloads and cache-hit equality
acceptance.decision: record full guided decision only if complete backup fits; otherwise explicit abstention, no fabricated partial ranking
acceptance.promotion: a budget-abstaining root does not authorize a chemistry-performance or docking comparison of this exact solver; qualify a bounded approximation first
acceptance.timeout: safety timeout is incomplete work, not a matched-budget scientific result

follow_on: independent chemistry development panel, then paired two-round T4 only after informative task value and proposal-efficiency gates; maximum 80 new docking calls across two arms
